Um... I hope I'm explaining this right, but I came in because... well, I just feel like I've got this motor running inside me all day. It's not that I'm trying to be a bother or anything, I promise. It's just, if I have to sit still—like when I'm at church, or waiting out there in the clinic, or even just sitting around at home—I start feeling kind of trapped? Like I just absolutely have to get up or do something with my hands. 

Does that make sense? I hope that's an okay reason to be here.
